name: A blessing for your week
title: A blessing for your week
caption:
Rest for your week ahead. Send this to someone you are praying for.

This verse is about the kind of rest that only comes from trusting God, the quiet sleep of someone who knows they are held. May it meet you and the one you send it to this week.

Psalm 4:8 (BSB)

Save it for a day you need it.
